files.rationale: Kept PR A's 3.6 main-line ElsaVersion and ElsaExtensionsVersion properties, since the merged Directory.Packages.props uses those variables and B's older 3.5 values would downgrade the main line.

Kept PR A's formatting and variable-based Elsa package group (including the new extension packages) and applied PR B's third-party version bumps (CodeBeam 8.2.1, ResxSourceGenerator 25218.8, MudBlazor.Translations 2.4.0, Radzen 7.0.6), which A did not touch.
PR A removed the whole Agents module (it now comes from the extensions packages), so B's package rename in this lone project file is moot.
Took PR A's restructured layout, which already includes B's Internal State section and the Default Configuration label, so both sides' intent is kept.
PR A's version already has B's changes (the @ref on the log persistence ExpressionEditor and the Default commit-strategy labels) in its new layout, so A's content is kept.
Kept A's switch from ISnackbar to IUserMessageService, and applied B's null! initializers and its added ShowTransitionDuration snackbar option to the UserMessageService call.
